category_title: Artistically-inclined students who adapt storytelling skills to technical 3D modeling
scenario_title: Adapting cinematic storytelling to technical game design
minimal_context: The student is using 3D modeling software in the lab to create a flying character asset for their game.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's focus on modeling the flying character for your game today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have the narrative planned out. I did research on bees' eating habits and incorporated my findings into the story, but making the actual 3D model is difficult.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to build the model in the software.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying, but modeling a flying character is a really challenging task to accomplish.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I never envisioned myself creating a game. I'm a filmmaker.
